instruction: Click the primary CTA on the landing page and tell me what happens.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Load the landing page.
2. Click the primary button.
3. Observe the outcome.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Load the landing page.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://www.example.com/")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Hero section with a `Start free trial` button.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click the primary CTA.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="a.cta-primary")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Navigated to /signup; heading `Create your account`.

**Final answer:** The `Start free trial` CTA navigates to the /signup page.

instruction: Double-click the file name in the list to rename it, then enter report-final.csv.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Locate the row.
2. Double-click to enter edit mode.
3. Type the new name.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Open the files list.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://drive.example.com/folder/7")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Row `report.csv` is listed.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Double-click the name to edit.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="td.name:has-text('report.csv')", click_count=2)`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Name switched to an inline text input.

**Step 3 — Thought:** Type the new name.
**Step 3 — Action:** `browser_type(selector="td.name input", text="report-final.csv", press_enter=True)`
**Step 3 — Observation:** Row now reads `report-final.csv`.

**Final answer:** Renamed report.csv to report-final.csv via double-click editing.

instruction: Open the context menu on the second row of the table.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Load the table.
2. Right-click a row.
3. Capture the menu items.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Load the table.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://app.acme.io/records")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Table with 25 rows.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Right-click the second row.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="tbody tr:nth-of-type(2)", button="right")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Context menu opened with `Open`, `Duplicate`, `Archive`, `Delete`.

**Final answer:** Right-clicking row 2 opened a context menu: Open, Duplicate, Archive, Delete.

instruction: Hover over the Products menu and click the Accessories sub-item.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Hover to reveal the submenu.
2. Locate the sub-item.
3. Click it.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Hover the top-level menu.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_hover(selector="nav > ul > li:has-text('Products')")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Mega-menu dropped down with 4 columns.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click the sub-item.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="a.submenu-item[href='/products/accessories']")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Navigated to `Accessories` listing.

**Final answer:** Hovering Products revealed the submenu; clicked through to the Accessories listing.

instruction: Drag the first kanban card from To do into the In progress column.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Locate the card and target column.
2. Perform the drag.
3. Verify the move.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Load the board.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://board.example.com/b/eng")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Columns: To do (4), In progress (2), Done (7).

**Step 2 — Thought:** Drag the top card to the In progress column.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_drag(source="[data-column='todo'] .card:nth-of-type(1)", target="[data-column='inprogress']")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Card moved; counts now To do 3, In progress 3.

**Final answer:** Moved the top To do card into In progress (To do 3, In progress 3).

instruction: Sort the orders table by clicking the Amount column header.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Load the table.
2. Click the header.
3. Read the first row.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Load the orders table.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://admin.example.com/orders")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Table unsorted; amounts appear in insertion order.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click the Amount header to sort descending.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="th[data-column='amount']")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Header shows a down arrow; top row is now order #9182 at $12,400.

**Final answer:** Sorting by Amount descending puts order #9182 ($12,400) on top.

instruction: Accept the cookie banner so it stops covering the page.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Wait for the banner.
2. Click Accept all.
3. Confirm it is gone.

**Step 1 — Thought:** The consent banner renders on first load.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://www.example.com/")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Banner `We use cookies` pinned to the bottom.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click Accept all.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="#cookie-banner button.accept-all")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Banner dismissed; `cookie_consent=all` cookie set.

**Final answer:** Accepted all cookies; the banner is gone and consent is stored.

instruction: Close the help modal with the Escape key.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Open the modal.
2. Press Escape.
3. Verify it closed.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Open the help modal.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="#open-help")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Modal `Help` visible with a close X.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Dismiss with the keyboard.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_press(key="Escape")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Modal removed from the DOM; focus returned to the trigger.

**Final answer:** Pressing Escape closed the help modal and restored focus to the trigger.

instruction: Tab through the fields on the signup form and report which control ends up focused.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Focus the first field.
2. Press Tab a few times.
3. Report the focused control.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Focus the first input.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="#first")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Focus in First name.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Advance focus twice.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_press(key="Tab")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Focus moved to Last name, then to Email.

**Final answer:** After tabbing twice from First name, focus lands on the Email field.

instruction: Expand the Billing section of the settings tree.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Locate the tree node.
2. Click to expand it.
3. Confirm the children appear.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Open the settings tree.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://app.acme.io/settings")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Tree root `Account` collapsed.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click the Billing node's disclosure triangle.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="[role='treeitem'][data-key='billing'] .expand")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Billing expanded; children `Invoices`, `Payment methods`, `Tax` now visible.

**Final answer:** Expanded Billing, revealing Invoices, Payment methods, and Tax.

instruction: Hold and drag the price slider to the right until it reaches the maximum.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Locate the slider.
2. Drag the handle.
3. Read the new value.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Open the filter panel.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://shop.example.com/products")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Price slider currently at $0-$1000.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Drag the upper handle to the far right.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_drag(source=".price-slider .handle-max", target=".price-slider .track-end")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Upper bound set to $2000; result count updates to 412.

**Final answer:** Dragged the max price handle to $2000, giving 412 matching products.

instruction: Select the option in the custom dropdown that is not a native select.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Open the custom listbox.
2. Pick an option.
3. Verify the chosen value.

**Step 1 — Thought:** The sort control is a custom listbox, not a <select>.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="div[role='combobox'][aria-label='Sort by']")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Listbox opened with options Price, Rating, Newest.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Choose Newest.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="li[role='option'][data-value='newest']")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Combobox label now reads `Newest`; grid reorders.

**Final answer:** Selected Newest in the custom sort listbox.

instruction: Click the tooltip trigger to read what the info icon says.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Hover the info icon.
2. Read the tooltip.
3. Report.

**Step 1 — Thought:** The info icon has a hover tooltip.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_hover(selector=".field-info[aria-describedby='tt-rate']")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Tooltip `Rate limit: 60 requests per minute` appeared.

**Final answer:** The info tooltip reads `Rate limit: 60 requests per minute`.

instruction: Toggle the row checkbox to select it, then confirm the bulk bar appears.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Load the table.
2. Check a row.
3. Confirm the bulk action bar.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Load the table.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://admin.example.com/users")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** 50 rows with checkboxes.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Check the third row.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="tbody tr:nth-of-type(3) input.row-select")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Checkbox checked; bulk bar shows `1 selected`.

**Final answer:** Selecting row 3 revealed the bulk action bar reading `1 selected`.

instruction: Scroll the pricing section into view and then click the Pro plan's choose button.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Scroll the plan into view.
2. Click its choose button.
3. Confirm the checkout page.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Scroll to the pricing grid.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_scroll(selector="#pricing", align="center")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Three plan cards visible; Pro in the middle.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click the Pro card's button.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector=".plan[data-tier='pro'] button.choose")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Navigated to /checkout?plan=pro.

**Final answer:** Clicked Pro and landed on /checkout?plan=pro.

instruction: Click the link that opens the changelog in a new tab, then switch to that tab.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Load the page.
2. Click the target=_blank link.
3. Switch tabs and confirm.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Load the release notes.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://app.acme.io/releases")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Page has a `View changelog` link.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click it - it opens in a new tab.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="a[target='_blank'][href='/changelog']")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** New tab opened at /changelog.

**Step 3 — Thought:** Switch to the new tab.
**Step 3 — Action:** `browser_press(key="Control+Tab")`
**Step 3 — Observation:** Active tab is now `Changelog - Acme`.

**Final answer:** Opened the changelog in a new tab and switched to it.

instruction: Sort the inbox by unread using the segmented control.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Open the inbox.
2. Click the Unread segment.
3. Confirm the filter.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Open the inbox.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://app.acme.io/inbox")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Segmented control: All, Unread, Flagged.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Click Unread.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="[role='tab']:has-text('Unread')")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Segment selected; list shrinks from 42 to 7 threads.

**Final answer:** Filtered the inbox to Unread, showing 7 threads.

instruction: Bulk-select all rows on the current page and delete them.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Select all rows.
2. Open the bulk menu.
3. Confirm deletion.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Load the drafts.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://app.acme.io/drafts")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** 20 draft rows, 20 per page.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Tick the header checkbox to select all.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="thead input.select-all")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** All 20 rows checked; bar reads `20 selected`.

**Step 3 — Thought:** Delete via the bulk menu.
**Step 3 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="button.bulk-delete")`
**Step 3 — Observation:** Confirm modal appeared. Confirmed; table now empty.

**Final answer:** Deleted all 20 drafts on the page after bulk-selecting with the header checkbox.

instruction: Click the canvas-based signature pad and draw a short stroke.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Locate the canvas.
2. Perform a drag to draw.
3. Confirm the pad registers input.

**Step 1 — Thought:** The signature pad is a <canvas>.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_navigate(url="https://sign.example.com/doc/88")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Canvas 600x200 present with placeholder `Sign here`.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Draw a diagonal stroke with a drag.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_drag(source="canvas#signature(300,150)", target="canvas#signature(420,70)")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** Pad registers strokes; `Clear` button becomes enabled.

**Final answer:** The signature canvas captured a stroke and enabled the Clear control.

instruction: Click the notification bell and tell me the top item.
output:
**Plan:**
1. Click the bell.
2. Read the dropdown.
3. Report the latest notification.

**Step 1 — Thought:** Click the bell in the header.
**Step 1 — Action:** `browser_click(selector="#notif-bell")`
**Step 1 — Observation:** Dropdown opened with 5 entries and a red badge reading 3.

**Step 2 — Thought:** Read the first entry.
**Step 2 — Action:** `browser_get_text(selector=".notif-list li:nth-of-type(1)")`
**Step 2 — Observation:** `Build #4127 failed on main (2 minutes ago)`.

**Final answer:** The newest notification is `Build #4127 failed on main (2 minutes ago)`.
